column1: # Handlers of the ARM-run host tokens in arm1.u (IRIX 6.5.30m). Produced by scripts/arm1_handlers.py
# from a linear scan of each function (no branch following). group: by function name, see the script.
# pops: payload reads seen in the function body (r9+0, r9+0x3c, r9+0x40); final: reads r9+0x3c.
# ge_handlers: engine handlers whose slot the body loads, in code order. ports: r9 offsets stored to.
